title: Nödnumret 112
request: A physical telephone and the exact source112digits,not a simulated live call or an invented contact number.

title: Bara akut nödsituation
request: Explicit ONLY acute-emergency gate before calling112; no invented symptom score,time limit or triage rule.

title: Liv, hälsa, egendom och omgivning
request: Four distinct source danger categories shown through person/heart,home/property and natural-environment objects. No real victim or fabricated incident.

title: Hjälp via nödnumret
request: Verified actual Finnish police/fire/ambulance vehicle photos as source examples,with social authority represented accurately; no claim a particular vehicle is dispatched to an invented incident.

title: Nödcentralen bedömer
request: Caller reaches emergency centre,which decides WHETHER help is needed AND WHICH authority; no automatic-all-services dispatch promise.

title: Samtalet är gratis
request: A real ordinary telephone object with a clear source no-charge cue; no tariff amount,brand recommendation or active number beyond112.

title: Anvisningar för samtalet
request: Source call checklist with phone,speech,address and listening symbols; do not add first-aid steps or a new call script.

title: Berätta vad som hänt
request: Caller and operator connected by a speech bubble indicating the actual-event description; no invented example emergency,patient or address.

title: Svara på frågorna
request: Distinct two-way question/answer bubbles between caller and operator,without fictional answers or extra identification demands.

title: Exakt adress och kommun
request: Actual Finnish public street-name/address sign,accurately identified; exact main wording still requires BOTH address AND municipality/city. No claimed incident at the photographed place.

title: Följ anvisningarna
request: Operator guidance followed by caller; unnumbered check mark,not a new medical procedure or fabricated emergency instruction.

title: Avsluta först när du får lov
request: Explicit permission-before-ending-call gate. No fake phone UI or suggestion that silence automatically means permission.

title: Varifrån du ringer
request: Caller-location address field and building/location marker; preserve this source wording separately from earlier help-needed address wording. No invented apartment number.

title: Hjälpen till rätt ställe
request: Retain the preceding meaningful location picture across this direct continuation; location allows help to reach the right place,without promising a named vehicle.

title: Vilken bostad i höghuset
request: Anonymous apartment building with several unlabelled units and question marker: technical call tracing does NOT tell the operator the particular apartment. No invented unit/address.

title: Berätta själv
request: Retain the apartment-specific location explanation across this direct source continuation; caller supplies the missing unit information.

title: Tolk vid behov
request: Caller,operator and interpreter in one connected conversation,with explicit IF NEEDED qualification; no universal immediate-language availability guarantee.

title: Säg språk i början
request: IF interpreter needed,tell the desired language clearly at the beginning; source timing is qualitative,no invented seconds or extra languages.

title: Stanna i samtalet
request: Retain the relevant interpreter-connection picture across this direct continuation,showing the call remains connected while translation is arranged.

title: Inte ringa i onödan
request: Non-emergency question is separated from the112acute-emergency route; no accusation against a real photographed caller.

title: Ring inte vid följande fall
request: Pictorial introduction limited to the following source non-emergency examples; preserve the conditions and ordinary-case scope.

title: Vanlig sjukdom, till exempel influensa
request: Ordinary/non-emergency illness example,without implying all influenza is harmless or adding a fever threshold/clinical assessment.

title: Hälsovårdscentralen som exempel
request: Verified Finnish health centre exterior as one alternative in the source ordinary-illness context; no fabricated phone number,current opening hours or individual appointment guarantee.

title: Allmänna frågor
request: Three actual source subject categories—healthcare,traffic,fire safety—shown as general information queries,not active emergencies.

title: Inget nödfall
request: General question and non-emergency scope remain explicit; the112route is blocked only for that source case.

title: Elavbrott eller kö utan fara
request: Actual power-outage object or traffic queue image only as an illustrative setting. Preserve IF NO ONE IS IN DANGER; do not infer absence of danger from an actual incident photo.

title: Andra slags ärenden
request: Source non-emergency utility/traffic questions outside emergency-centre responsibility; no additional agency contact or current service promise.

title: Inte brådskande
request: Explicit IF matter is not urgent,do not call112; no new definition of urgency or symptom criteria.

title: Vanliga sjukdomsfall
request: Ordinary illness separated from acute-emergency care,using neutral medicine/clinic objects without assigning a diagnosis to a real person.

title: Polisens tillståndsärenden
request: Verified Finnish police institution or generic anonymous permit document; contextual ordinary permit query,not an allegation of an actual offence.

title: Hjälpen kan försenas
request: Unnecessary call occupies an operator while a real-emergency route waits; qualitative possible delay only,no invented queue time or number of calls.

title: Missbruk kan straffas
request: Conditional legal consequence for misuse,using statute/scales; no fine amount,prison term,actual offender or invented case.

title: Utbildad operatör
request: Accurately identified emergency-centre workplace or ordinary headset object; avoid real caller records,screens with personal data and unverified worker identities.

title: Frågor och hjälpbehov
request: Operator questions feed a help-needs assessment,without diagnosing or inventing categories beyond the source.

title: Därefter larmas hjälp
request: Distinct actual Finnish response vehicle/agency context,without a fabricated current dispatch or guarantee which service attends.

title: Operatörens anvisningar
request: Different source-specific guidance relationship: operator explains what caller should do; do not add medical or rescue instructions.

title: Besvara frågorna noga
request: Operator remains the source call interlocutor rather than transferring it to a named responder; do not misrepresent later interpreter-bridge statements as impossible.

title: Gratis från alla telefoner
request: Distinct real telephone object,not a fake live call. Illustrate the source no-charge statement without adding claims about absent network coverage or switched-off devices.

title: Inget riktnummer
request: The exact112digits with a visibly unnecessary prefix field; no example country/area code that could be mistaken for actual instructions.

title: Utländskt mobilabonnemang
request: Foreign mobile subscription still uses112without prefix,matching source; no invented roaming charge,network or country-specific rule.

title: 112 i EU
request: Accurate verified EU flag and telephone112symbol; no fabricated country borders,membership list or non-EU scope.

title: Finska, svenska och engelska
request: Three exact source service languages clearly distinguished; no inferred nationality or language ability of a real person.

title: Telefontolk vid språkbehov
request: IF none of the three source languages are known,an interpreter may be used; no automatic instant-connection guarantee.

title: Börja med ditt språk
request: State your actual language first,with an empty language field/phone symbol rather than an invented language utterance or caller identity.

title: Vänta på tolken
request: Retain the preceding relevant language-connection image across the direct continuation; wait for operator to connect interpreter,no fabricated waiting time.

title: Vanligen tryggt
request: Verified calm Finnish public environment,illustrative only. Keep usually/vanligen qualification; no invented risk statistics or claim serious crises never occur.

title: Förberedd sedan länge
request: Neutral household preparedness object or source-specific home/long-standing-practice diagram; no unprovided stockpile list,quantities or preparedness rule.

title: Exempel på oväntade situationer
request: Accurately identified actual storm/flood/power-outage setting as one source-listed example; not a current emergency or invented cause. Other source examples remain in full exact text.

title: Förberedelse hjälper dig att agera
request: Prepared home/person plus response plan and shield,showing source preparedness relationship without adding new actions,guarantees or kit quantities.
